pages.title: Giving it a voice
text: Bring your grown familiar within **6 blocks** of a Resonance Totem and **sneak-use a Bonding Charm on the totem**. Your nearest familiar that does not carry that voice yet takes it. The charm is not spent.
The totem rings, a thread of its colour runs to the familiar, and from then on it shimmers in that colour. Its voice shows when you look at it, and on your Ley Lens.
A [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem) cannot give a voice. Use a Resonance Totem.

pages.title: One voice each
text: A familiar carries one voice at a time. Take it to another totem to change it whenever you like.
Several familiars can carry several voices. Every one following you counts, and so does the nearest one left waiting ([what a voice gives](familiar_boons)).
The voice is the familiar's own: its young are born without one.

pages.title: Totem and familiar
text: An attuned familiar keeps every totem of its voice within **8 blocks** answered, and wakes one that has gone quiet ([keeping](keeping)). Leave one waiting beside a totem you seldom visit.
Use a totem with an empty hand to hear which familiars keep it. If none do and your own familiar is close, the totem tells you how to attune it.
